data_point: Professional services business serving a single metro area
run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company is a professional services business selling billed labour locally: marketing or creative agency, IT or managed-service shop, staffing firm, consultancy.
prompt.definition: These convert and earn a smaller positive score. Mutually exclusive with 'Startup selling nationally'.
yes_when: An agency, consultancy, IT shop or staffing firm serving clients mainly in one metro area
no_when: The company sells a scalable product, or serves clients nationwide with a product
unknown_when: Can't tell where the clients are or whether it sells labour
watch_out_for: Accounting and bookkeeping firms are an exclusion, not this signal
A design agency with global clients and no product: answer 'no' and explain

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Denver's full-service marketing agency. Serving businesses across the Front Range since 2009.

output.reason: A local marketing agency serving one metro area.
